v1.0.0.description:
Initial release of the Ape Escape 2 Archipelago implementation.

- Send locations by catching monkeys
- Receive gadgets and level unlocks
- Randomise the order of levels
- Choose to play as Hikaru or Kakeru (Jimmy or Spike)
- Customise your experience with different logic difficulties and trick toggles
- Optionally lock the "Air Crawl" glitch behind an item
- Full YAML-less Universal Tracker support for all options
- Complete your seed by beating "Showdown with Specter!" or "Final Showdown with Specter!"

For instructions, see the [Setup Guide.](https://github.com/dannybonz/ae2_archipelago/blob/main/docs/setup.md)
v1.0.0.title: Ape Escape 2 Archipelago v1.0.0

v1.0.1.description:
- Fixed an issue where the Stun Club would automatically be equipped, even if it wasn't unlocked.
- Fixed an issue where gadgets would sometimes not be automatically equipped.
- Improved the client connection process.
- Added additional indicators to the client to help with diagnosing connection issues.
- Prevented received death links from triggering if the player is not currently in a level.
- Added Linux support (untested).
- Logic adjustments.

For instructions, see the [Setup Guide.](https://github.com/dannybonz/ae2_archipelago/blob/main/docs/setup.md)
v1.0.1.title: Ape Escape 2 Archipelago v1.0.1

v1.1.0.description:
- Added optional locations behind message phones.
- You can now choose to start without the Monkey Net - or any gadgets at all! Starting without the Monkey Net requires that message phone locations be enabled.
- Added location groups for each level.
- Fixed Linux support.
- Logic adjustments.

For instructions, see the [Setup Guide.](https://github.com/dannybonz/ae2_archipelago/blob/main/docs/setup.md)
v1.1.0.title: Ape Escape 2 Archipelago v1.1.0

v1.2.0.description:
- Added an option to **randomise each level's starting room!**
- Added an option to **randomise the music played within each level or room!**
- Added more customisability for the behaviour of the "Air Crawl" glitch: "default" (vanilla behaviour), "patched" (the glitch cannot be performed), "item" (the glitch can be performed after receiving "Catapult" and "Air Crawl") or "progressive" (the glitch can be performed after receiving two "Progressive Catapult" items).
- Added an option to place extra "World Key" items into the pool, making it easier to unlock levels.
- Fixed a bug where the "Vita-Z Factory: "Climbing Tutorial" Phone" location would not send.
- Message phone locations will now be forced off when playing as Kakeru.
- Logic improvements.

For instructions, see the [Setup Guide.](https://github.com/dannybonz/ae2_archipelago/blob/main/docs/setup.md
v1.2.0.title: Ape Escape 2 Archipelago v1.2.0

v1.3.0.description:
- Added an option to **enable locations within the Gotcha Box!**
- The procedure of redeeming items from the Gotcha Box has been streamlined. Standing on the button will allow you to **continuously redeem items** without having to break any capsules.
- You can customise how new Gotcha Box items become available. Even if Gotcha Box items are technically accessible, **logic will not expect you to grind them all out immediately**. The number of levels unlocked and amount of monkeys caught will always be considered when determining the pace at which you are logically expected to redeem Gotcha Box locations.
- Gotcha Box locations can be locked behind level unlocks, "Gotcha Box Restock" items or nothing at all.
- Attempting to use the Gotcha Box when no items are available will result in the machine refusing to take your coins.
- Added items for **mini-game and R.C. car body unlocks**.
- Added a new option to include filler items for each of the game's **Monkey Fables, Movies, Soundtracks, Comic Strips, Concept Artwork, Secret Photos and Stage Photos**.
- **Added new traps: "Lazy Camera Trap", "Rocket Boots Trap" and "Slowness Trap".** You can adjust the percentage of filler items that are replaced with traps and the weight for each individual trap being chosen in your YAML.
- Universal Tracker is now integrated directly into the client.
- Overhauled client status display.
- Fixed a bug where you could be given an invisible Dash Hoop after exiting a room transition when playing with no starting gadgets.
- Logic improvements.

For instructions, see the [Setup Guide.](https://github.com/dannybonz/ae2_archipelago/blob/main/docs/setup.md
v1.3.0.title: Ape Escape 2 Archipelago v1.3.0
